status_note: V2 question clusters (THI-13, DEC-028; content THI-15). A cluster groups programs and holds an ordered list of questions addressed by position (1, 2, 3, ...). Scored questions are Q1-Q4; Q5-Q7 are reserved for future scored precision (BR1/PR1/PR2/CR1 are reality checks placed after the scored questions, so their ids leave B5-B7, P5-P7 and C5-C7 free). The schema has no fixed question count, only each cluster's max_questions. The tech cluster holds only T1, the Spotify opener, which REUSES V1 Q1 (same options and copy, no copy of its own) so its answer carries into the V1 precision module and is never asked twice (THI-14, DEC-030). Scenario questions name the project(s) they open via project_ids. Options name the program(s) they point to; reality-check options point to none, carry a reality_level, and name the program(s) they are about via reality_for_program_ids; they never rank. Company names are hypothetical scenario context, not the measured signal. Weights and stop rules belong to the THI-14 engine, not to this data.
